tools.description: Adjusts the volume of an audio file by a specified dB amount.

input_audio_uri.description: URI of the input audio file (local path or gs://).

output_file_name.description: Optional (deprecated; use output_filename). Desired name for the output audio file.

output_filename.description: Optional. Desired name for the output audio file. The client-provided extension is honored and selects the output format. Takes precedence over the deprecated output_file_name. If omitted, a unique name is generated. An existing file of the same name is overwritten.

output_gcs_bucket.description: Optional. GCS bucket to upload the output audio file to.

output_local_dir.description: Optional. Local directory to save the output audio file.

volume_db_change.description: Volume change in dB (e.g., -10 for -10dB, 5 for +5dB).

tools.name: ffmpeg_adjust_volume

tools.description: Combines separate audio and video files into a single video file.

input_audio_uri.description: URI of the input audio file (local path or gs://).

input_audio_volume_db_change.description: Optional. Volume change in dB for the input audio track (e.g., +5).

input_video_uri.description: URI of the input video file (local path or gs://).

input_video_volume_db_change.description: Optional. Volume change in dB for the input video's audio track (e.g., -10).

output_file_name.description: Optional (deprecated; use output_filename). Desired name for the output video file (e.g., 'combined.mp4').

output_filename.description: Optional. Desired name for the output file (e.g., 'combined.mp4'). The client-provided extension is honored and selects the output format. Takes precedence over the deprecated output_file_name. If omitted, a unique name is generated. An existing file of the same name is overwritten.

output_gcs_bucket.description: Optional. GCS bucket to upload the output video file to.

output_local_dir.description: Optional. Local directory to save the output video file.

tools.name: ffmpeg_combine_audio_and_video

tools.description: Concatenates multiple media files. If output is WAV, inputs must be PCM WAV; otherwise, inputs are standardized to MP4/AAC before concatenation.

input_media_uris.description: Array of URIs for the input media files (local paths or gs://).

output_file_name.description: Optional (deprecated; use output_filename). Desired name for the output file (e.g., 'concatenated.mp4'). Extension determines behavior for audio concatenation.

output_filename.description: Optional. Desired name for the output file (e.g., 'concatenated.mp4'). The client-provided extension is honored and selects the output format (and determines behavior for audio concatenation). Takes precedence over the deprecated output_file_name. If omitted, a unique name is generated. An existing file of the same name is overwritten.

output_gcs_bucket.description: Optional. GCS bucket to upload the output file to.

output_local_dir.description: Optional. Local directory to save the output file.

tools.name: ffmpeg_concatenate_media_files

tools.description: Converts a WAV audio file to MP3 format using FFMpeg.

input_audio_uri.description: URI of the input WAV audio file (local path or gs://).

output_file_name.description: Optional (deprecated; use output_filename). Desired name for the output MP3 file (e.g., 'converted.mp3'). If omitted, a unique name is generated.

output_filename.description: Optional. Desired name for the output file (e.g., 'converted.mp3'). The client-provided extension is honored and selects the output format. Takes precedence over the deprecated output_file_name. If omitted, a unique name is generated. An existing file of the same name is overwritten.

output_gcs_bucket.description: Optional. GCS bucket to upload the output MP3 file to.

output_local_dir.description: Optional. Local directory to save the output MP3 file.

tools.name: ffmpeg_convert_audio_wav_to_mp3

tools.description: Gets media information (streams, format, etc.) from a media file using ffprobe. Returns JSON output.

input_media_uri.description: URI of the input media file (local path or gs://).

tools.name: ffmpeg_get_media_info

input_audio_uris.description: Array of URIs for the input audio files to layer (local paths or gs://).

output_file_name.description: Optional (deprecated; use output_filename). Desired name for the output mixed audio file (e.g., 'layered_audio.mp3').

output_filename.description: Optional. Desired name for the output file (e.g., 'layered_audio.mp3'). The client-provided extension is honored and selects the output format. Takes precedence over the deprecated output_file_name. If omitted, a unique name is generated. An existing file of the same name is overwritten.

output_gcs_bucket.description: Optional. GCS bucket to upload the output file to.

output_local_dir.description: Optional. Local directory to save the output file.

tools.description: Overlays an image onto a video at specified coordinates.

input_image_uri.description: URI of the input image file (local path or gs://).

input_video_uri.description: URI of the input video file (local path or gs://).

output_file_name.description: Optional (deprecated; use output_filename). Desired name for the output video file (e.g., 'overlayed_video.mp4').

output_filename.description: Optional. Desired name for the output file (e.g., 'overlayed_video.mp4'). The client-provided extension is honored and selects the output format. Takes precedence over the deprecated output_file_name. If omitted, a unique name is generated. An existing file of the same name is overwritten.

output_gcs_bucket.description: Optional. GCS bucket to upload the output video file to.

output_local_dir.description: Optional. Local directory to save the output video file.

tools.name: ffmpeg_overlay_image_on_video

tools.description: Creates a GIF from an input video using a two-pass FFMpeg process (palette generation and palette use).

fps.description: Frames per second for the output GIF (e.g., 10, 15, 25).

input_video_uri.description: URI of the input video file (local path or gs://).

output_file_name.description: Optional (deprecated; use output_filename). Desired name for the output GIF file (e.g., 'animation.gif'). If omitted, a unique name is generated.

output_filename.description: Optional. Desired name for the output file (e.g., 'animation.gif'). The client-provided extension is honored and selects the output format. Takes precedence over the deprecated output_file_name. If omitted, a unique name is generated. An existing file of the same name is overwritten.

output_gcs_bucket.description: Optional. GCS bucket to upload the output GIF file to (uses GENMEDIA_BUCKET if set and this is empty).

output_local_dir.description: Optional. Local directory to save the output GIF file.

scale_width_factor.description: Factor to scale the input video's width by (e.g., 0.33 for 33%). Height is scaled automatically to maintain aspect ratio. Use 1.0 for original width.

tools.name: ffmpeg_video_to_gif
